verdict.rationale: Adyen's manage-cards docs cover activating, suspending (temporarily stopping payment processing) and permanently closing cards, and cards are paymentInstrument resources updated via /paymentInstruments/{id}, so the core status lifecycle appears to be API-driven. Lost-card reporting is only mentioned as part of the Raise disputes API rather than as a card status, and unpausing is only implied by suspension being temporary. Missing for 10: explicit unpause/reactivation call, a dedicated lost/stolen card status, reissue with a replacement linked to the original, explicit API request examples for each status transition, and independent corroboration.
